name: Memory
description: Notes kept across chats in plain Markdown you can edit: memory.md in your config folder (every chat) and .byob/memory.md in a workspace. Their start goes into the system prompt; the model adds and removes notes with remember and forget; the Memory pane shows and edits them.

tools.name: remember
tools.title: Remembered: {text}
tools.description: Save a short note for future chats: a lasting preference or fact the user stated.

scope.description: global (default): every chat; workspace: this project only.

tools.name: forget
tools.title: Forgot: {text}
tools.description: Delete a saved note, by its text or a unique part of it.
